info.description: Health-education tutor with a local learner model. Design: docs/System_Design_v3.md

get.description: Allowed even when a password change is pending, so the client knows to ask for it.

post.description:
POST + fetch streaming so the cookie/session and per-question method are preserved.

Progress events contain fixed status text/scores only, never question or passage text.
Instructor display-off suppresses progress and routing diagnostics server-side.

delete.description: Forget the learning profile (state, evidence, preferences). The account and consent stay.

get.description: Sanitized history of one of the caller's own sessions (oldest first).
